spans.s:
trayá, a. triple, threefold, 57^13; as n. triad,
triplet, τριάς. [tri, 489^4.]

√tras (trásati; tatrā́sa, tatrasús, treṣús
[794e^2]; átrāsīt; trasiṣyáti; trastá).
tremble; fear. [cf. τρέω, τρέσ-σε, ‘tremble,
trembled’; Lat. terreo, ‘affright’; a-trastas
and ἄ-τρεστος, ‘unterrified.’]

trasádasyu, m. Trasadasyu, a generous
prince, the favorite of the gods, and descended
from Purukutsa. [Perhaps for
trasád-dasyu, ‘affrighting the evil beings,’
see 1309^4. √tras.]
